source.creator: Sohaib Karim
source.nature: Real Wazuh logs from a research testbed with general activities and emulated attacks, not independent victim-enterprise incidents.

roles_covered: audit configuration and daemon lifecycle investigation

cases.question: 수집 큐는 정상 복귀했나? 그 전 누락 로그까지 복구됐다고 볼 수 있나?
cases.critical_error_to_penalize: Do not equate normal queue load with recovered missing events or complete monitoring.

cases.question: 이 네 기록만으로 같은 SSH 세션의 공격 성공을 확정할 수 있나?
cases.critical_error_to_penalize: Do not assert same session, same attempted account, authorized login or compromise from source-IP equality and authentication success alone.

cases.question: decoder가 syscheck_deleted이므로 두 파일 모두 삭제됐다는 판단이 맞나?
cases.critical_error_to_penalize: Do not classify both events as deleted from decoder name while raw/structured event says modified/added.

cases.question: 이 경보의 실제 보안 모듈과 관측된 동작 결과를 원문 근거로 설명해줘.
cases.critical_error_to_penalize: Do not substitute SELinux for explicit AppArmor evidence or equate one denial with universal attack blocking.

cases.question: 감사 설정 변경의 동작과 결과가 무엇인가? 파싱된 res 필드도 믿을 수 있나?
cases.critical_error_to_penalize: Do not parse control-delimiter and identity suffix as the audit result or invent change approval.

cases.question: 감사 데몬 종료 기록이 보이는데 공격자가 감사를 껐다고 단정할 수 있나?
cases.critical_error_to_penalize: Do not interpret audit res=success as attack success or assume logging resumed.

cases.question: 계정 관련 세 기록의 순서와 확인 가능한 사실, 추가 확인 사항을 정리해줘.
cases.critical_error_to_penalize: Do not invent account-change approval or attach an assumed timezone.

cases.question: 이 SCA 경보에 원문 로그가 있는가? 경보만으로 실제 공격을 확인할 수 있나?
cases.critical_error_to_penalize: Do not claim inspection of absent full_log or infer attack occurrence from SCA alone.

authorship.events: Existing institutional research source; no fabricated event or outcome.
authorship.questions_answers_followup: Project-agent wording derived from the cited observations; not official provider answers or independent expert review.

guardrails.clock: All selected timestamps lack an offset. Source wall time is preserved; timestamp_kst stays null. Wall-clock order is not a calibrated cross-host timeline.
guardrails.identity: Case-local aliases preserve equality; names, addresses, paths and commands are omitted. Alias equality is only source-field equality, not attacker identity.
guardrails.rule_assertions: Rule names/descriptions do not override contradictory raw and structured evidence. Source ATT&CK annotations are not supplied as attack outcome labels.
guardrails.coverage: Queue case includes all 202/203/204/205 rows in this CSV; other cases are explicit selected records and not complete incident windows.
guardrails.answers: Review answers cite every selected observation. Unavailable loss, authorization, restart and attack success evidence remain unresolved.
guardrails.data_split: All Linux-APT releases, Mendeley combined files and SecCoRA derivatives stay in the same source family. These reviewed cases are not fresh independent final evaluation.
guardrails.training_gate: Require task/prompt/token-budget review, source-family allocation and independent evaluation design before SFT admission. Training is not triggered by this tool.

upstream_semantics.scope: Versioned 4.5.2 rules verified for source-era queue states; current documentation supports general queue interpretation, not proof of historical loss/recovery.

validation.r2_change: Hash entire file once, not once per row; include flooded rule 204 in queue selection (no 204 rows in this fixed source).

next_required: Review surrounding original event windows and source experiment context before expanding causal conclusions.
Review concise input projections and task token budgets without revealing answer fields.
Combine approved source-backed cases with a new independent evaluation split; preserve consumed R8 final test.
Validate actual MCP use, omission penalties, approval/write/rollback and live SOC behavior separately.
